n = int(input())
b = int(input())

a = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

oddCount = [0] * n
evenCount = [0] * n

if a[0] % 2 == 0:
    evenCount[0] = 1
else:
    oddCount[0] = 1

for i in range(1, n):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]

costs = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    if evenCount[i] == oddCount[i]:
        costs.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

costs.sort()
totalUsed = 0
cutsMade = 0
for cost in costs:
    if totalUsed + cost <= b:
        totalUsed += cost
        cutsMade += 1
    else:
        break

print(cutsMade)
